Code: DescriptionMismatch's format-2 arm (Length = SIZE integer; LocaleSymbol.SameLocaleAs over the external identification; IsCurrent for the no-locale-name form). Every branch probed (gen4.py, BY REFERENCE into a class method): L1 same name LC, en-US vs de-DE -> refused 'LOCALE mismatch'; L2 SIZE 12 vs 14 -> refused; L3 different names LC/LD both "en-US" -> runs (same external identification); L4 identical -> runs; L5 no-locale-name vs named -> refused; L6 both without a name -> runs. No spec-derived INVOKE test pins it (test-needed). CITATION NOTE: cite.py --check finds the quoted text in §9.3.6 but resolves the printed path wrongly (the lettered/numbered sub-items are transcribed at column 0 — open kb/Work PB718); the path used here is read off the printed text. || REFUTED: PARTIAL — The static (typed object reference) half is implemented and probed: OoConformance.DescriptionMismatch's format-2 LOCALE arm compares SIZE (Length), picture string and locale identity, and the adjudicator's six typed probes reproduce. But 9.3.6 is the RUNTIME method-resolution rule ('the class of the actual object referenced at runtime is used'); through a universal object reference (the path where the binding really is decided at runtime) the LOCALE picture - category numeric-edited - has no conformance descriptor (ConformanceDescriptor falls to 'T:!' for every category except numeric/alphanumeric/object-reference), so OoBindUniversalInvoke rejects the INVOKE COBOL0866 before any match is attempted, even when the locales and SIZE agree. The rule is therefore never evaluated on the dynamic path and legal source is refused. Two halves, one verified => PARTIAL. No spec-derived test pins either half (test-ref empty).
